incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4721 triggered -> high 'route-fanout' error-rate (auto-threshold). prob: synthetic-probe failures across eu-west-1. pd link: https://pd.example/INC-4721 :rotating_light:
jamal: acked. i'm the oncall. taking triage. any visible customer impact?
maria: seeing a tiny error bump on prod proxy traces, but 95th latency looks normal. most hits are 500s from the synthetic probe group.
jamal: ok grabbing dashboards. point me to the probe job name?
maria: job is infra/synthetics/canary-probe-eu. it's a high-frequency canary we rolled last week.
jamal: i can see burst at 16:58:05 -> 16:58:45, ~40s window. 500s from a routing change rollback. looks correlated with a quick canary rollout.
jamal: mitigation plan: disable canary in-flight, let traffic stabilize. will run the toggle.
jamal: ```bash
# disable canary temporarily
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://infra-api/flags/canary-probe-eu/disable
# confirm
curl https://infra-api/flags/canary-probe-eu | jq '.'
```
devops-bot: flag canary-probe-eu set -> disabled by jamal (runbook step: disable canary if synthetic causes noise).
maria: i see errors dropping already, error-rate back to baseline at 16:59:20. nice.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4721 auto-resolved (no escalation required). resolution: transient synthetic probe spike.
sophie: quick note: let's add a narrow suppression for that probe job in the alert policy and add a 30s cool-down window; otherwise flapping will wake oncalls for harmless blips. i'll open a follow-up PR.
jamal: handing off to maria to watch for 30m and confirm no linked customer errors. maria, any customer-facing checks you want?
maria: i'll monitor request-errors-by-customer and the SLO dashboard, will call if anything deviates. thanks. :thumbsup:
jamal: thx. marking as resolved in chat. leaving a short runbook comment and follow-up ticket for suppression rule.
sophie: filed ticket INF-8916 to add suppression + doc note. assigned to eng-infra.
maria: all good from my side; closing loop. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Note: last_alert_ts=8399901111, resolved_ts=8399901165, auto-resolve=true
jamal: good catch everyone — low-severity, no customer impact, action items created. moving to monitoring state.
